parent_channels.name: Singular Identity and Relational Comparison

subchannels.name: Absolute Oneness and Exhaustive Exclusion
subchannels.scene_or_process: Positive singular identity is paired with negative quantification over every possible member of a class.
subchannels.active_motifs: absolute unity `ء ح د:B001/m01`; emphatic repeated one `ء ح د:B001/m02`; exhaustive negative “any one” `ء ح د:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The positive use fixes an identity as one without qualification, and emphatic repetition intensifies that unity. In a negative frame, the same lexical field expands from one individual to anyone whatsoever, making singularity and exhaustive exclusion complementary operations.

subchannels.name: Counterpart, Fitness, and Recompense
subchannels.scene_or_process: Two parties are tested for parity, then aligned through fitness, opposition, or an equivalent return.
subchannels.active_motifs: equal counterpart `ك ف ء:B001/m01`; marital or martial fitness `ك ف ء:B001/m02`; recompense in kind `ك ف ء:B001/m03`; paired correspondence `ك ف ء:B001/m04`
subchannels.synthesis: Counterpart relation becomes a mechanism of comparison: parties may be equal, suitably matched, opposed on equal terms, or answered with like for like. The surface denial of a counterpart therefore opens onto a wider lexical system of parity and reciprocal balance.

subchannels.name: Acting and Arriving Singly
subchannels.scene_or_process: A collective resolves into independent actors or a sequence of isolated arrivals.
subchannels.active_motifs: acting alone `ء ح د:B005/m01`; arriving one by one `ء ح د:B005/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Singularity becomes an enacted social arrangement rather than only an attribute: participants separate, act independently, and appear as successive individuals.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: An entity is located as absolutely one, universally unmatched, relatively equal, or operationally separate.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 112:1 `أحد` states singularity, while 112:4 `كفوا أحد` excludes any counterpart.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The comparison field extends into marital and martial fitness, reciprocal recompense, and solitary procession.

parent_channels.name: Origination and Lineage

subchannels.name: Parents, Parturition, and Offspring
subchannels.scene_or_process: Parent roles, the act and timing of birth, and the resulting child form one generational scene.
subchannels.active_motifs: offspring or descendant `و ل د:B001/m01`; father `و ل د:B002/m01`; mother `و ل د:B002/m02`; parental pair `و ل د:B002/m03`; human parturition `و ل د:B003/m01`; impending birth `و ل د:B003/m02`; newborn child `و ل د:B004/m01`; birth-age term extended to a young female slave `و ل د:B004/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The two surface verbs evoke a complete generational frame even while negating it: progenitors, delivery, its temporal threshold, and offspring. The newborn designation also reaches into household status through its use for a young female slave, carrying an age-marked term beyond the biological event.

subchannels.name: Causal Products and Coming-to-be
subchannels.scene_or_process: Something arises from a source, enters occurrence, and may bear the marks of innovation or mixed provenance.
subchannels.active_motifs: causal generation `و ل د:B005/m01`; coined speech `و ل د:B005/m02`; derived or locally formed provenance `و ل د:B005/m03`; occurrence and presence `ك و ن:B001/m01`; temporal coming-to-be `ك و ن:B001/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Birth is generalized into source-to-result causation. A thing may be produced by another, a saying may be newly coined, and a person or language may emerge in a mixed or local form; the existence root supplies the outcome as an event that has come to be.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A source gives rise to an outcome through biological birth, causal production, or derivation.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 112:3 `يلد` and `يولد` activate both directions of the birth relation.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Biological descent extends into coined speech, derived language, mixed provenance, and the general coming-to-be of events.

parent_channels.name: Number, Order, and Temporal Position

subchannels.name: Cardinal Composition and Calendar Order
subchannels.scene_or_process: A single unit enters arithmetic composition, ordinal position, and calendrical naming.
subchannels.active_motifs: cardinal one `ء ح د:B003/m01`; compound eleven `ء ح د:B003/m02`; first in a construct `ء ح د:B004/m01`; Sunday as the named day `ء ح د:B004/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The unit “one” can be counted, combined with ten, or recast as first. Its ordinal force also names Sunday, linking numerical structure to the recurring order of the week.

subchannels.name: One-by-one Distribution
subchannels.scene_or_process: Members of a group are serialized as separate arrivals.
subchannels.active_motifs: successive individual arrival `ء ح د:B005/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Number becomes distributive motion: the group is not merely counted but presented as a sequence of single persons, each occupying a distinct turn.

subchannels.name: Coevality and Remembered Youth
subchannels.scene_or_process: People are positioned in time either as age-peers or through an elder’s contrast between present age and former youth.
subchannels.active_motifs: coeval or age-peer `و ل د:B006/m01`; elder defined by “I was in my youth” `ك و ن:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: One relation synchronizes two lives at the same age, while the other folds a single life across past and present. Together they form a temporal comparison scene of co-presence and retrospection.

subchannels.name: Annual Birth and Alternating Yield
subchannels.scene_or_process: Animal birth and agricultural or pastoral products are organized into yearly, alternating production cycles.
subchannels.active_motifs: animal parturition `و ل د:B003/m03`; annual crop or camel yield `ك ف ء:B005/m01`; yearly milk, wool, and offspring return `ك ف ء:B005/m02`; alternating camel birth cohorts `ك ف ء:B005/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: Reproduction becomes scheduled yield. Births, fruit, milk, wool, and offspring are reckoned by year, while dividing camels into two cohorts turns recurrence into an alternating management system.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Discrete units are counted, ordered, distributed, compared by age, or arranged in recurring time.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 112:1 and 112:4 anchor `أحد`, while 112:3 `يلد` and 112:4 `كفوا` supply indirect temporal extensions.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The one-unit field reaches eleven, Sunday, one-by-one arrival, remembered youth, and alternating annual herd production.

parent_channels.name: Orientation, Authority, and Care

subchannels.name: Worship and the Invoked Divine Name
subchannels.scene_or_process: A worshipper directs devotion toward one made the object of worship and addresses the divine name in oath or invocation.
subchannels.active_motifs: devotional worship `ء ل ه:B001/m01`; worshipped entity `ء ل ه:B001/m02`; making an object worshipped `ء ل ه:B001/m03`; divine name `ء ل ه:B002/m01`; oath formula `ء ل ه:B002/m02`; vocative invocation `ء ل ه:B002/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: The divine name occupies both relational poles: it identifies the worshipped object and provides the form by which a speaker swears or calls. The lexical field also exposes the social act that constitutes something as an object of worship.

subchannels.name: Sought Patron and Directed Reliance
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person deliberately turns toward a dependable patron for affairs and needs.
subchannels.active_motifs: aiming toward and relying upon `ص م د:B001/m01`; lord or patron sought for needs `ص م د:B001/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Direction and dependence form one action: the seeker chooses a destination because the figure approached is the one on whom affairs and needs can rest.

subchannels.name: Responsible Authority and Negotiation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A ranked authority gives operative speech, sponsors a dependent, oversees an affair, and negotiates its disposition.
subchannels.active_motifs: chieftain whose word carries force `ق و ل:B004/m01`; rank or standing `ك و ن:B002/m02`; establishment in position `ك و ن:B002/m03`; sponsorship and guarantee `ك و ن:B003/m01`; oversight of an affair `ص م د:B005/m01`; attentive concern for it `ص م د:B005/m02`; negotiation `ق و ل:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Rank is converted into responsibility. The authoritative speaker can negotiate an affair, stand over it attentively, and guarantee another person, joining verbal force to institutional care.

subchannels.name: Solicitude in Adversity
subchannels.scene_or_process: Sincere concern is directed toward someone or something in a bad condition.
subchannels.active_motifs: sincere care `ق و ل:B015/m01`; adverse condition `ك و ن:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The speech root shifts from utterance to committed concern, while the existence root supplies the distressed state that calls forth that concern. Care is defined here by sustained attention to adversity.

subchannels.name: Doctrine and Submission
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person adopts a doctrinal position and embodies allegiance through submission.
subchannels.active_motifs: belief or school affiliation `ق و ل:B013/m01`; submissive posture `ك و ن:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: A “saying” becomes a held doctrine rather than a spoken sentence, and the adopted position becomes a social posture of yielding to what one follows.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Participants direct worship, need, allegiance, responsibility, or concern toward an asymmetrically positioned figure.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 112:1-2 `الله` identifies the addressed and worshipped figure, and 112:2 `الصمد` names the one sought and relied upon.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Devotional orientation expands into civic rank, sponsorship, negotiation, doctrinal submission, and solicitude under adversity.

parent_channels.name: Speech, Thought, and Semantic Form

subchannels.name: Vocal Delivery and Speaker Capacity
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker externalizes language through the tongue, with fluency or abundance characterizing the speaker.
subchannels.active_motifs: vocalized saying `ق و ل:B001/m01`; tongue as speech instrument `ق و ل:B002/m01`; fluent or loquacious speaker `ق و ل:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Thought becomes audible through a bodily instrument, and repeated facility in that act becomes a stable quality of the person who speaks.

subchannels.name: Inner Proposition and Supposition
subchannels.scene_or_process: A proposition remains inward or operates as a supposition before any public utterance.
subchannels.active_motifs: unexpressed inner speech `ق و ل:B012/m01`; proposition functioning as supposition `ق و ل:B011/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Saying is detached from sound and retained as mental content. That content can then function as a judgment or hypothesis, especially in questioning, without first becoming voiced speech.

subchannels.name: Speech Ownership, Falsification, and Circulation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A statement is fabricated, assigned to a speaker, appropriated by another, and released into public circulation.
subchannels.active_motifs: fabricated falsehood `ق و ل:B005/m01`; attribution of unsaid words `ق و ل:B005/m02`; appropriation of a saying to oneself `ق و ل:B006/m01`; circulating report or reputation `ق و ل:B007/m01`; recurring gossip `ق و ل:B007/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The scene tracks a proposition through contested ownership. It may be invented, imposed on someone who did not say it, drawn toward oneself, and finally dispersed among people as favorable or unfavorable report.

subchannels.name: Signification, Definition, and Predication
subchannels.scene_or_process: Content is made knowable through a thing’s indication, a logical boundary, or a predicative construction.
subchannels.active_motifs: nonverbal indication `ق و ل:B014/m01`; logical definition or limit `ق و ل:B016/m01`; copular, emphatic, or exceptive predication `ك و ن:B001/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: “Saying” can be performed by a thing that signifies without speech or by a definition that fixes conceptual limits. The predicative use of being supplies the grammatical operation that asserts, emphasizes, or excludes within a proposition.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Meaning moves among vocal delivery, inward conception, source attribution, public circulation, and formal predication.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 112:1 `قل` initiates vocal declaration, while 112:4 `يكن` supplies a predicative frame.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Saying extends to the tongue as instrument, silent thought, rumor, false attribution, nonverbal signs, and logical definition.

parent_channels.name: Material Solidity, Closure, and Shelter

subchannels.name: Cavityless Solidity and Anchored Terrain
subchannels.scene_or_process: Dense, cavityless matter forms hard ground, fixed rock, and elevated terrain located in a definite place.
subchannels.active_motifs: compact solidity without a cavity `ص م د:B002/m01`; hard or elevated place `ص م د:B002/m02`; anchored rock and severe ground `ص م د:B002/m03`; place or location `ك و ن:B002/m01`; Mount Uhud `ء ح د:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Solidity scales from material texture to landscape. Dense matter becomes hard ground and fixed rock, location gives it spatial placement, and Mount Uhud supplies the fully named elevated setting.

subchannels.name: Stoppered Vessel
subchannels.scene_or_process: A fitted plug closes and secures the mouth of a bottle.
subchannels.active_motifs: bottle stopper `ص م د:B003/m01`; act of stoppering `ص م د:B003/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The object and operation form a compact containment mechanism: a closure is made for the vessel and then set in place to seal it.

subchannels.name: Fabric Closures for Body and Dwelling
subchannels.scene_or_process: Cloth is fitted and fastened to stabilize the head or close the rear of a shelter.
subchannels.active_motifs: binding the head with cloth `ص م د:B004/m01`; sewn rear tent panels `ك ف ء:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The same functional pattern operates at two scales. A cloth secures the body, while one or two sewn panels close and shape the back of a tent or dwelling.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A space, container, body, or dwelling is stabilized by dense matter or a fitted closure.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 112:2 `الصمد`, 112:4 `يكن` and `كفوا`, and 112:1/4 `أحد` provide the lexical anchors for the concrete constructions.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The material field spans cavityless rock, Mount Uhud, a bottle stopper, a bound head, and sewn tent panels.

parent_channels.name: Applied Force and Response

subchannels.name: Striking and Redirection
subchannels.scene_or_process: Applied force strikes a target or changes the orientation and course of an object or group.
subchannels.active_motifs: staff blow `ص م د:B006/m01`; game stick used to strike `ق و ل:B008/m01`; tilting, inversion, or upending `ك ف ء:B002/m01`; tilting a bow or dish `ك ف ء:B002/m02`; diverting a group `ك ف ء:B002/m03`; swaying motion `ك ف ء:B002/m04`; Mount Uhud as setting `ء ح د:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Two wooden implements supply the tool-and-impact pattern, while the motion field supplies its possible effects: tilting, overturning, diversion, and sway. Mount Uhud gives the construction a concrete geographic setting for the staff-strike scene.

subchannels.name: Bodily Yielding and Endurance
subchannels.scene_or_process: Pressure produces either visible bodily disturbance or continued functioning through severe conditions.
subchannels.active_motifs: downcast face or changed color `ك ف ء:B002/m05`; persistence and survival `ص م د:B007/m01`; camel enduring cold and drought while maintaining milk `ص م د:B007/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The two outcomes contrast yielding with resistance. One body registers disturbance in face and color; the enduring camel remains productive through cold and drought, turning persistence into sustained life under pressure.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: External pressure produces impact, redirection, visible yielding, or sustained resistance.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 112:1 `قل`, 112:2 `الصمد`, and 112:4 `كفوا` and `أحد` anchor the latent tool, action, motion, and setting senses.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: A game stick and a staff blow join Mount Uhud, redirected travelers, swaying vessels, a changed face, and a drought-enduring milk camel.

parent_channels.name: S1. Composed Speech with Rhyme Mismatch
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A composed poem or speech is evaluated for formal correspondence, and its rhyme fails to align.
parent_channels.active_motifs: composed verbal form `ق و ل:B001/m02`; rhyme mismatch in letters, vowels, or inflection `ك ف ء:B003/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Structured language supplies the verbal artifact, while rhyme mismatch identifies a defect in its patterned ending. The result is a complete scene of poetic composition assessed through formal correspondence.
